segments.text: V. 43. But how dreadful will be the Conſequence of their rejecting Me? When the unclean ſpirit go•• out—Not willingly, but being compelled by one that is ſtronger than he. He walketh—Wanders up and down; thro' ary places—Barren, dreary, deſolate; or, Places not yet watered with the Goſpel: Seeking reſt and findeth none—How can he, while he carries with him his own Hell? And is it not the Caſe of his Children too? Reader, Is it thy Caſe?
